name: Terra Quantum
description: Terra Quantum is a Swiss quantum technology company developing a hybrid quantum-classical computing platform for enterprise applications. The company combines quantum algorithms with classical computing infrastructure to deliver practical quantum solutions for optimization, machine learning, and cryptography challenges.

products.name: TQ42 Platform
products.description: Hybrid quantum-classical computing platform delivering optimization, machine learning, and cryptography solutions for enterprise

highlights: Over $85M in funding for hybrid quantum-classical enterprise solutions
100+ employees across quantum algorithms, ML, and cryptography teams
Serves enterprise clients in optimization, machine learning, and security

news.title: Terra Quantum AG to go public in $3.25 billion SPAC deal
news.excerpt: Non-binding letter of intent with Mountain Lake Acquisition Corp. II values the St. Gallen-based quantum firm at $3.25B ahead of a planned Nasdaq listing.
